scenarios.name: Inspect an inactive project without activating it

scenario_steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the Projects dialog lists an active project and another project
the active project is marked in the list
the user selects the other project with a single click
the other project row is highlighted
the settings tree displays information for the selected project
the active-project mark remains beside the original project
the chooser still displays the original active project
